ticker_news.title: Thinking of Buying Amazon Stock? The Company's Biggest Moneymaker Might Surprise You.
ticker_news.description: Amazon's retail business is just a facade, as its services segment, including AWS and third-party seller fees, generates the majority of its revenue and profits. Investors should focus on Amazon as a service company rather than a retailer.
ticker_news.author: The Motley Fool

ticker_news.title: 3 Top Buffett Stocks to Buy and Hold for the Long Haul
ticker_news.description: The article discusses three stocks that Warren Buffett's Berkshire Hathaway has invested in: Amazon, Domino's Pizza, and Pool Corporation. It analyzes the growth potential and long-term prospects of these companies, highlighting their strong business models and competitive advantages.
ticker_news.author: Jon Quast

ticker_news.title: Steadfast and Strong: Invest in These 2 Durable American Giants
ticker_news.description: The article discusses two American stocks, American Express and Amazon, that are well-positioned to benefit from the U.S. government's America-first strategy and the growth of AI and cloud computing in the country.
ticker_news.author: Brett Schafer
